title: Monthly Care Add-Ons Repriced by a New Assisted Living Care Level
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, monthly add-ons the new level reprices are not billed twice for the days covered by the level-increase charge:

1. When an **escort assistance** or **incontinence care** add-on billed for the month is included at the new level, every such included add-on is offset in full for the days covered.
2. When none is included but an **insulin management**, **diabetic monitoring** or **oxygen management** add-on billed for the month is priced lower at the new level, the amount by which each was billed above the new level's fee is offset for the days covered.
3. Otherwise nothing is offset.

"Billed for the month" means the add-on charges of that kind carrying the billing month of the most recent full-month care fee charge; "the new level" is the care level the residency now carries. The add-on offset is each offset monthly amount divided by the days in the month, for each day covered. The offset is subtracted from the difference as the charge bills it for the days covered, that is after any share of the difference has been taken, never taking the charge below zero; the charge is rounded once to the cent at the end. Illustration (hypothetical): a difference of 392.666… for the days covered, of which the charge bills 0.75, is 294.50; less an offset of 196.666… it leaves 97.833… before rounding.

### What each level includes and charges (US dollars per month)

| | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Escort assistance included | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Incontinence care included | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Insulin management fee | 465.00 | 465.00 | 465.00 | 365.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Diabetic monitoring fee | 185.00 | 185.00 | 185.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Oxygen management fee | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

### Cases (hypothetical; 20 days covered in a 30-day month)

| Increase | Add-ons billed for the month | Monthly amount offset | Offset for the days covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level 3 to Level 4 | Escort assistance 295.00, insulin management 465.00 | 295.00 (escort now included; with an included add-on present, the insulin reprice is not offset) | 295.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 20: 196.666… |
| Level 4 to Level 5 | Insulin management 365.00, oxygen management 150.00 | 365.00 plus 150.00, that is 515.00 | 343.333… |
| Level 1 to Level 2 | Insulin management 465.00 | Nothing: not included at Level 2 and not priced lower | 0.00 |
| Level 2 to Level 3 | Incontinence care 385.00, diabetic monitoring 185.00 | 385.00 (incontinence care now included) | 256.666… |
